run_tree_walk_calculator: run a full history tree walk to compute Q-values and counterfactual reach probabilities for each player
compute_action_values: compute action values per state for each player given a list of policy objects
get_tabular_statistics: get tabular numpy arrays of action values, counterfactual reach probs, and player reach probs from a calculator
get_root_node_values: get root node values only by searching nodes with positive probability without populating meta information dictionaries
call_calculator: call the TreeWalkCalculator with policies and a tabular policy to compute and return action value statistics
